title: Eliminator 500 SE Cruiser (Touring Pack)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Kawasaki Eliminator 500 SE Cruiser (Touring Pack) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 500cc powertrain delivering 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
